body: Tracked as a PE-side bug in PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#8710 (DE Filing Status 4 non-refundable credits capped against combined tax instead of each spouse's own — same root cause as #996 / policyengine-us#7931; those two pe-us issues should be de-duplicated). Closing here as diagnosed + tracked.
